metadata.title: Doo It! — Your personal workout app
metadata.description: 800+ illustrated exercises, strength and cardio routines, no ads and no sign-up.

hero.title: Your workout. Your way.
hero.description: 800+ illustrated exercises. Strength and cardio routines. No ads, no sign-up — just training.

showcase.imageAlt: Doo It! screens showing workouts, progress, muscles and reminders

features.title: Everything you need to train better.
features.description: Find the right exercise, build a routine around your goals, and stay focused through every set.

cards.title: Explore
cards.body: Find the right exercise from more than 800 illustrated movements organized by muscle group.

cards.title: Build
cards.body: Create strength and cardio routines that fit your goals, schedule, and available equipment.

cards.title: Train
cards.body: Follow every exercise, set, and repetition in a simple experience that keeps you moving.

insights.title: See your progress at a glance.
insights.description: Turn every session into clear charts and detailed reports. See your exercises, sets, reps, and training history in one visual summary.
insights.imageAlt: Workout charts and detailed training reports in Doo It!

share.title: Make every workout worth sharing.
share.description: Turn your training into a visual recap you can save, share, and feel proud of — from the first set to the last rep.
share.imageAlt: Shareable workout recap in Doo It!

privacy.title: Your workouts stay yours.
privacy.description: No account, no cloud, and no tracking. Your routines and training history stay securely on your device, under your control.

cta.title: Grab everything you need and get started.
cta.description: Choose your exercises, build a routine around your goals, and start training. Doo It! keeps everything else simple.

metadata.title: Join the closed beta — Doo It!
metadata.description: Join the Doo It! closed beta and help us bring a private, distraction-free workout app to Google Play.

beta.title: Help Doo It! reach Google Play.
beta.description: Join the first group of testers, try the app before launch, and help us make every workout experience better.
benefits: A direct way to share feedback
Your email used only for beta access

form.title: Save your spot.
form.description: Use the same Google Account email you have in the Play Store.
form.consent: I agree that Doo It! may use this email only to manage my closed beta invitation.
form.status: We will send a secure link to confirm that the email belongs to you before adding it to the list.
form.success: Check your inbox. If the address can receive invitations, you will find a confirmation link valid for 30 minutes.
form.error: We could not complete registration right now. Refresh the security check and try again.
form.verified: Your email is confirmed. You are now on the closed beta waitlist.
form.verificationInvalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Submit your email again to receive a new one.

beta.privacyNote: No spam. No advertising lists. You will be able to request deletion at any time.
